speaker: Li
text: Hey Sarah, can you help me review this PR before we deploy it?

speaker: 李
text: 嘿 Sarah，你能帮我看一下这个 PR 在我们 deploy 之前吗？

speaker: Sarah
text: Sure, let's take a look. Did you run the build to check for any bugs?

speaker: Sarah
text: 当然，我们来看看。你跑了 build 来检查有没有 bug 吗？

speaker: Li
text: Yes, I ran the build and fixed all the bugs I could find. I think we're almost ready to merge this.

speaker: 李
text: 是的，我跑了 build 并修复了所有我能找到的 bug。我觉得我们快要可以 merge 了。

speaker: Sarah
text: Great job! Just one thing, there's a small issue with the deadline for this feature. Can we push it back a day?

speaker: Sarah
text: 做得好！只有一件事，这个 feature 的 deadline 有个小问题。我们能把它往后推一天吗？

speaker: Li
text: No problem, I'll update the deadline in the ticket. Let's make sure everything is good to go before we deploy.

speaker: 李
text: 没问题，我会在 ticket 里更新 deadline。我们在 deploy 之前确保一切就绪。

speaker: Sarah
text: Sounds good. I'll give it one last review and then we can go ahead and merge. Thanks for your hard work, Li!

speaker: Sarah
text: 听起来不错。我会最后审核一下然后我们可以 merge。谢谢你的辛勤工作，Li！
